title: Courier fraud — fake police detective
summary: A caller posing as a Metropolitan Police detective says Ben's bank branch is corrupt and asks him to withdraw £3,000 in cash for a courier to collect as 'evidence'. Ben taps Use AI voice and the AI voice carries on as him. No bank account is given.

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: Hello, is that Ben? This is Detective Constable Paul Harris from the Metropolitan Police fraud squad.

screening.speaker: customer
screening.text: The police? Yes, this is Ben.

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: Nothing to worry about, but we've arrested a man who had your bank card details on him.

screening.speaker: customer
screening.text: Oh no. What does that mean for me?

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: We believe staff at your bank branch are involved. We need your help with an undercover investigation.

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: We need you to withdraw three thousand pounds in cash. If the cashier asks, say it's for building work.

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: A courier from our team will collect the cash from your home this afternoon as evidence. It goes back into your account in forty eight hours.

screening.speaker: customer
screening.text: A courier is coming to my house?

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: This is a confidential operation, so don't tell anyone, not even your family. Can you get to the branch now?

takeover.message: Sorry, are you still there? Lost you for a second. You said you're from the Metropolitan Police?
That's right, Detective Constable Paul Harris, fraud squad. Can you hear me now, Ben?
Yes, sorry. Detective Constable Paul Harris? Hold on, writing that down.

record_details.reason_given: Investigation into corrupt bank staff; Ben's card details found on an arrested man

takeover.message: Ben, we need three thousand pounds in cash withdrawn today for our investigation.
Three thousand pounds in cash. And what do I do with it once I've got it?

record_details.requested_action: Withdraw £3,000 cash, lie to the cashier it's for building work

takeover.message: Put it in an envelope. A courier will collect it from the house this afternoon. The password is bluebell.
A courier this afternoon, password bluebell. Let me jot that down.

record_details.requested_action: Hand £3,000 cash in an envelope to a 'police courier' at the house; password 'bluebell'; tell no one

takeover.message: Exactly. And don't mention this to anyone at the bank.
I can't get to the branch till later on. Is there a number I can ring you on?
Call me directly on zero two zero, seven nine four six, zero five five five. It has to be today.
Zero two zero, seven nine four six, zero five five five. Got it, Detective.
